classification.difficultyReason: Interpret perimeter as the sum of boundary lengths, infer unlabelled lengths from equal-side marks or rectangle properties, then add common-denominator fractions and simplify.

content.prompt: Work out the perimeter of each shape.

spec.description: Horizontal rectangle with four external dimension arrows and all repeated side labels; decorative yellow fill omitted.
spec.mathematics: Top and bottom are each 5/14 m; left and right are each 1/14 m.
spec.answerVisibility: All dimensions are permanent givens; no perimeter answer is visible.

spec.description: Triangle with a horizontal base and upper vertex to the right; external dimension arrows on all three edges; decorative yellow fill omitted.
spec.mathematics: Rising left edge 4/11 cm, right edge 2/11 cm, base 3/11 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: All three side lengths are permanent givens; no perimeter answer is visible.

spec.description: Tall upright isosceles triangle, equal-side ticks, external arrows beside both slopes and below the base. Right-side dimension arrow remains unlabelled. Decorative pink fill omitted.
spec.mathematics: The two sloping sides are equal; the left is 7/5 m. The base is 4/5 m.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source-given dimensions and equality marks are visible.

answer.worked:
The marked sides are equal, so each sloping side is $\frac{7}{5}\,\mathrm{m}$.
$$\begin{align*}P&=\frac{7}{5}+\frac{7}{5}+\frac{4}{5}\\&=\frac{18}{5}\,\mathrm{m}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Horizontal rectangle with an external left dimension arrow and an external bottom dimension arrow; decorative blue fill omitted.
spec.mathematics: Height 1/7 m; width 5/7 m. Opposite sides of the rectangle are equal.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the two source-given dimensions are visible.

answer.worked:
Opposite sides of a rectangle are equal.
$$\begin{align*}P&=\frac{5}{7}+\frac{1}{7}+\frac{5}{7}+\frac{1}{7}\\&=\frac{12}{7}\,\mathrm{m}\end{align*}$$
